_note: Composable creature traits (Caves of Qud-style parts): each trait is data for a generic engine handler in src/core/creature_traits.gd / creature_ai.gd / creature_roster.gd. New creatures list trait ids in payload.traits; established v1 creature definitions are never edited, so they receive traits through `assign` here.

fears_fire.name: Fears fire
fears_fire.description: Keeps its distance from anyone wielding fire; fights only when cornered.

thick_coat.name: Thick coat
thick_coat.description: Cold barely touches it; fire bites deep.

hard_shell.name: Hard shell
hard_shell.description: Blades and blunt blows glance off; lightning cracks it.

pack_caller.name: Pack caller
pack_caller.description: Howls when it finds prey; kin nearby join the hunt.

charger.name: Charger
charger.description: Rushes in a straight line from 2-3 tiles for a heavy blow, then needs time to gather itself.

slinger.name: Slinger
slinger.description: Keeps distance and aims at your position. Step aside during the wind-up or break line of sight.

spellcaster.name: Spellcaster
spellcaster.description: Aims an elemental bolt at your position. Move during the wind-up; close in or use cover.

fears_ice.name: Fears ice
fears_ice.description: Keeps away from a traveller wielding ice.
